scenes.name: Mobile Coffee Kiosk
scenes.description: 4-stage coffee workflow: detect/grasp cup, place under spout avoiding espresso column, press spring brew button, serve at pickup counter.

scenes.name: PCB Pick-and-Place & Test Cell
scenes.description: 3-stage PCB workflow with suction end-effector: vacuum-pick PCB from infeed tray over divider wall, place on test fixture, then transfer to outfeed bin.

scenes.name: PCB AOI & Sorting Cell
scenes.description: 4-stage AOI continuity test fixture and Pass/NG sorting cell with dual bins and divider keepouts.

scenes.name: Aluminum Assembly & Screw Fastening Cell
scenes.description: 2-point automated M3 screw fastening workflow with electric screwdriver: align bit with M3 screw targets on aluminum assembly carrier and fasten with torque feedback.

scenes.name: Laboratory Desktop Pick & Place
scenes.description: SO-ARM101 table sorting cell: pick cube from feeder tray and place into sorting bin with obstacle avoidance.
